$PROB PHENO 1COMP IV BOLUS, BAYES (GIBBS/METROPOLIS), WEAK PRIORS P:100base F:BASE $INPUT ID DAT2=DROP TIME AMT RATE CMT DV MDV EVID WT BWT SEX APGR CREA TAFD=DROP $DATA ../../data/pheno-nm.csv IGNORE=@ $SUBR ADVAN1 TRANS2 $ABBR DERIV2=NO
$PK ; MU referencing: each ETA is attached to exactly one MU_n = f(THETA) MU_1 = LOG(THETA(1)) MU_2 = LOG(THETA(2)) CL = EXP(MU_1 + ETA(1)) V = EXP(MU_2 + ETA(2)) S1 = V
$ERROR IPRE = F W = 1 W = SQRT(THETA(3)**2 + THETA(4)**2 * IPRE**2) IF (W.LT.1E-6) W = 1E-6 IRES = DV - IPRE IWRE = IRES / W Y = IPRE + W * EPS(1)
$THETA (0, 0.0075) ; CL (L/h) (0, 1.5) ; V (L) (0, 0.6) ; additive error SD (mg/L) (0, 0.12) ; proportional error CV
$OMEGA BLOCK(2) 0.3 0.05 0.3
$SIGMA 1 FIX
; Weak priors. THETA: normal with huge variance. OMEGA: inverse Wishart with the ; smallest degrees of freedom (2 = dimension). The prior on OMEGA is required by ; BAYES; the THETA prior is made uninformative on purpose. $PRIOR NWPRI $THETAP (0.0075 FIX) (1.5 FIX) (0.6 FIX) (0.12 FIX) $THETAPV BLOCK(4) FIX 1000 0 1000 0 0 1000 0 0 0 1000 $OMEGAP BLOCK(2) FIX 0.3 0.05 0.3 $OMEGAPD (2 FIX) $EST METHOD=BAYES INTER NBURN=3000 NITER=5000 PRINT=500 NOPRIOR=0 NOABORT SEED=20260917 $TAB ID TIME AMT DV MDV EVID CMT IPRE IWRE CWRES ONEHEADER NOPRINT FILE=sdtab $TAB ID CL V ETA1 ETA2 ONEHEADER NOPRINT NOAPPEND FILE=patab $TAB ID WT BWT CREA APGR ONEHEADER NOPRINT NOAPPEND FILE=cotab $TAB ID SEX ONEHEADER NOPRINT NOAPPEND FILE=catab
